title: An oxygen between carbons
hook: Inspect the bonds and identify the functional group.

knows: Lines in a structural formula represent chemical bonds.
doesNotKnow: An ether contains an oxygen bonded to two carbon groups, shown here as CH₃–O–CH₃.

misconception: Every molecule with the same element contains the same functional group.
objective: Recognize the stated functional group from condensed structural connectivity.

claims.text: Question, structure and explanation: Which listed functional group best describes the distinctive group in this condensed structural diagram? This diagram represents dimethyl ether. An ether contains an oxygen bonded to two carbon groups, shown here as CH₃–O–CH₃. Lines show bonds; grouped labels such as CH₃ are condensed notation.
The diagram is a condensed 2D structural representation, not a model of molecular geometry.
Recall: Which group is illustrated in the dimethyl ether example? An ether contains an oxygen bonded to two carbon groups, shown here as CH₃–O–CH₃.
